what: hand labels of sentence pairs (same bench, different runs) for calibrating the tf-idf cosine threshold; S = states substantially the same rule, R = related / overlapping but not the same rule, D = different. Single rater (the analyst writing the record), judged on the pair text only, not blind to the cosine value. Pairs were sampled per cosine band (<=10 per band 0.15-0.30, all pairs above 0.30, 12 from 0.10-0.15) with random.Random(20261023) / (20261024) on the universe built by analyze_shared.build_universe.
